utility.name: validate-storage
utility.purpose: Comprehensive validation tool for storage system. Checks schema, referential integrity, file existence, orphan detection, ID format, date format, required fields, duplicates, version validation, length limits.
utility.output: Validation report with pass/fail per check

utility.name: test-edge-cases
utility.purpose: Edge case and boundary testing suite. 35 tests covering malformed JSON, long descriptions, special characters, ID format violations, category mismatches, version issues, duplicate detection.

utility.name: repair-storage
utility.purpose: Automated repair tool. Fixes versions, dates, rebuilds category indexes, removes duplicates, truncates long descriptions. Supports --dry-run mode.

utility.name: kb-validator
utility.purpose: Validates KB entries and index.json consistency. Checks YAML frontmatter required fields, builds_on references, index entry/file matching, tag_index completeness, category consistency, team ID format.

utility.name: index-rebuilder
utility.purpose: Auto-generates index.json by scanning KB entries and team sessions. Supports --dry-run and --fix modes with diff output.

utility.name: cross-ref-checker
utility.purpose: Validates all cross-references. Checks KB builds_on chains, team session KB references, script dependencies. Detects cycles via DFS, finds orphans and dangling entries.
utility.output: Dependency tree and structured JSON report

utility.name: fast-search
utility.purpose: High-speed full-text search index compiled in Go. Builds inverted index of .md, .json, .py, .go files. Supports exact match, multi-word AND, and phrase search. Query time <5ms.
utility.output: JSON results with file, line, column, context

utility.name: fast-validate
utility.purpose: High-speed repository structure validator in Go. Validates all index.json files, cross-references, file existence, orphan detection, dependency cycle detection in single pass. <2ms runtime.
utility.output: JSON report with pass/fail and all issues

utility.name: fast-cache
utility.purpose: High-speed file-based key-value cache for API responses in Go. SHA-256 keys. Supports get, set (with TTL), delete, stats, gc, keys. Sub-millisecond cache hits.

utility.name: kb-search
utility.purpose: Full-text search across KB entries, team logs, and script metadata using TF-IDF ranking. CLI with argparse supporting query, --tags, --category, --type filters.

utility.name: handoff-tracker
utility.purpose: Parses Handoff Notes from team session logs, extracts action items, checks if subsequent teams addressed each item. Tracks resolution rate across iterations.

utility.name: staleness-detector
utility.purpose: Repository health checker with 6 checks: stale statuses, regressions, unaddressed handoffs, broken references, index mismatches, orphan files. Outputs scored health report.

analysis.name: grade-research
analysis.purpose: Evaluates research JSON quality across five dimensions: citation count/quality, coverage breadth, depth (word count), and specificity (metrics, tools, code). Outputs graded report with recommendations.
analysis.output: Graded report with scores and recommendations

analysis.name: merge-research
analysis.purpose: Merges multiple team research JSON files by topic category. Deduplicates using string similarity, identifies coverage gaps, outputs unified research document.

analysis.name: data-gathering-benchmark
analysis.purpose: Benchmark harness running all data gathering methods against test query, timing them, calculating quality scores based on result count, source diversity, information density.
analysis.output: Benchmark results JSON with speed and quality scores

data-collection.name: data-gathering-websearch
data-collection.purpose: Multi-query web search via DuckDuckGo. Generates 3-5 query variants and deduplicates results by URL.

data-collection.name: data-gathering-wikipedia
data-collection.purpose: Wikipedia API deep extraction with DuckDuckGo fallback. Extracts summaries, sections, references, categories.

data-collection.name: data-gathering-arxiv
data-collection.purpose: arXiv academic paper search with DuckDuckGo fallback. Extracts titles, authors, abstracts, categories, dates.

data-collection.name: data-gathering-hybrid
data-collection.purpose: Hybrid multi-source aggregation combining 5 methods (web, Wikipedia, arXiv, OpenAlex, Wikidata). Parallel execution, credibility tiers, TF-IDF deduplication, weighted corroboration scoring.

data-collection.name: data-gathering-iterative
data-collection.purpose: Iterative deepening search doing 3 rounds of progressively deeper DuckDuckGo queries. Each round refines queries based on previous results.

data-collection.name: ddg-utils
data-collection.purpose: Shared DuckDuckGo search utilities. Contains parser class, search function, rate limiting (0.5s between requests), configurable User-Agent. Extracted from 4 duplicate implementations.

data-collection.name: request-cache
data-collection.purpose: File-based HTTP response cache with SHA-256 keys, base64 storage, configurable TTL (default 1 hour). Functions: cached_request(), clear_cache(), cache_stats().

data-collection.name: data-gathering-openalex

data-collection.name: data-gathering-hackernews
data-collection.purpose: Hacker News search via Algolia API plus Firebase top stories. Extracts titles, URLs, authors, points, comment counts. Deduplicates across both sources.

data-collection.name: data-gathering-guardian

data-collection.name: data-gathering-semantic-scholar

data-collection.name: data-gathering-wikidata
data-collection.purpose: Wikidata knowledge graph search. Two-phase: searches entities then fetches full details including labels, descriptions, key properties, Wikipedia sitelinks.

data-collection.name: data-gathering-github
data-collection.purpose: GitHub repository and code search via REST API. Searches repos by stars, extracts descriptions, languages, topics, licenses, fork counts. Graceful rate-limit handling.

tools.name: Sonnet Research API
tools.description: Multi-agent research system using Claude Sonnet. Supports variable sub-agents, request queuing, priority scheduling, result sorting, and automated import into repo storage.

config.py.purpose: Central configuration. Model set to claude-sonnet-4-6. Rate limit 50 req/min, max 3 concurrent. Retry with [1s, 2s, 4s] backoff. Queue max 500.

client.py.purpose: Thin wrapper around Anthropic SDK. Provides query() and query_batch() with structured QueryResult/QueryError returns. Session-level token tracking. Retry on RateLimitError, APIConnectionError, InternalServerError.

queue_manager.py.purpose: Thread-safe priority queue with rate-limited concurrent processing. RequestQueue class with enqueue(), process_queue(), get_status(), get_all_results(). Uses PriorityQueue with negated priorities.

researcher.py.purpose: Multi-step research orchestrator. Supports quick (0 follow-ups), standard (2), and deep (5) depth modes. Initial query -> follow-up rounds -> synthesis. Saves results as JSON.

orchestrator.py.purpose: Main entry point. ResearchOrchestrator coordinates multiple SonnetResearchers. spawn_researchers() for simple topics, run_research_mission() for structured missions with priority sub-tasks. Progress callbacks.

sorter.py.purpose: Result sorter/grouper/categorizer. sort_by_relevance (keyword TF scoring), sort_by_depth, sort_by_topic (greedy clustering), categorize(), filter_results(), export_sorted(), generate_index().

data_importer.py.purpose: Imports research results into repo structure. import_to_knowledge_base() creates MD entries, import_to_sources() creates source JSON, import_to_api_tools() creates tool JSON. update_indexes() refreshes all index.json files.

code_quality_notes: Well-structured with clear separation of concerns
Good error handling with structured error types
Uses relative imports (from config import ...) which requires running from the package directory
No __init__.py in the sonnet-research-api directory - not a proper Python package

notes: 38 individual .json source definition files exist in storage/sources/
The sources/index.json lists 35 sources but some have dedicated per-file JSON definitions beyond what the index tracks
Duplicate FRED entry: SRC-0003 and SRC-0018 both reference FRED API

architecture.message_bus: JSONL append-only files with O_APPEND atomic writes (POSIX guarantees <4096 bytes)
architecture.shared_state: SQLite WAL with BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions
architecture.cleanup: EpochRotator for hourly JSONL rotation, SQLite cleanup_expired()

core.py.notes: Clean separation of concerns. Thorough validation including /tmp rejection (EN-4), NFS detection (EN-5), canonical path enforcement (SB-1/SB-2), write permission checks (EN-1).

bus.py.notes: POSIX atomic writes via O_WRONLY|O_APPEND|O_CREAT. Message size limit enforced at 4096 bytes. Reader tracks offset for incremental polling. Handles partial lines correctly. repair_bus_file for corrupt line removal.

state.py.notes: WAL mode with configurable busy_timeout. _retry_on_busy decorator for SQLITE_BUSY handling. BEGIN IMMEDIATE in reserve_api_call prevents TOCTOU (RC-4 fix). Proper transaction isolation.

coordinator.py.notes: Full lifecycle management. Coordinator with heartbeat loop, agent health monitoring, phase transitions, blocker handling. Worker with watchdog integration. EpochRotator prevents unbounded JSONL growth (RE-1).

strengths: Zero bugs found in deep stress testing
Active SQLite-based rate limiting prevents API abuse (BEGIN IMMEDIATE)
JSONL provides durable, human-readable message history
Comprehensive coordinator watchdog for death detection
Clean graceful shutdown with daemon threads

architecture.message_bus: Named pipes (FIFOs) with spillover files for offline messages
architecture.shared_state: mmap with struct packing and fcntl.flock()
architecture.threading: select.select() event-driven coordination (vs Proto A polling)

key_differences_from_a.bus: FIFOs consume data on read (no persistent history) vs JSONL append-only
key_differences_from_a.state: Fixed-size mmap (10368 bytes, max 32 agents, max 16 rate limits) vs dynamic SQLite

known_bugs_found: flock() is per-fd per-process: DOES NOT serialize threads sharing the same fd. Rate limiter is broken under multi-threaded access.
_init_header() used self._lock() (no-op lock with fd=None) instead of self._flock() - fixed to use self._flock()
CoordinatorWatchdog called get_heartbeat() which initially did not exist on SharedStateMap - added
Coordinator.check_agents() accessed agent['agent_id'] but get_dead_agents() returns AgentSlotView dataclasses, not dicts - uses .agent_id attribute instead
No persistent message history makes debugging harder
Spillover files can accumulate unboundedly if no reader attaches
what_could_be_backported: select.select() event-driven coordination could replace Proto A's polling loops for lower CPU usage and faster reaction times
SpilloverCleaner's get_spill_size() monitoring metric could be added to Proto A for bus directory size monitoring
The concept of backpressure (FIFO full -> EAGAIN) is missing from Proto A's write-always approach

categories_covered: Stress tests (10 concurrent agents, mixed ops, lifecycle, throughput): 4 tests
Message flood - 5000 messages from 5 writers (2 tests)
Rate limit extreme contention - 20 threads (2 tests)
Heartbeat accuracy under heavy I/O (1 test)
Large message edge cases - 4095/4096/4097 bytes (4 tests)
Phase transition during active work (3 tests)
RC-4 TOCTOU rate limit race (1 test)
Mmap concurrent writes (2 tests - including flock threading bug test)

gaps: No unit tests for Sonnet Research API modules (client.py, queue_manager.py, researcher.py, orchestrator.py, sorter.py, data_importer.py)
No tests for data-gathering methods (method_websearch.py, method_arxiv.py, etc.) - only benchmarks
No tests for utility scripts (kb_validator.py, index_rebuilder.py, cross_ref_checker.py, etc.)
No tests for Go compiled tools (fast_search, fast_validate, fast_cache)
No integration tests verifying Proto A bus_cli.py coordination system end-to-end
No tests for visualization scripts (viz_kb_graph.js, viz_data_flow.js, viz_team_hierarchy.js)
